notes: «وعبد الله، ابنى محمد» : the appositive «ابنى محمد» describes the two co-transmitters; it is not a link, and the father is not written as a name after «أبيهما»
«عن أبيهما» is a bare relation (rule 7): kind relation, not completed
Ali is the last link; the saying is his relation of the Prophet's prohibition
